title: Adamski photos unanalyzed; diaries read by Glenn Steckling
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Adamski photos unanalyzed; diaries read by Glenn Steckling, about 1950s at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
plain: A researcher named Clas Svahn, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about George Adamski, a man known in the 1950s for photos he said showed craft from elsewhere. Svahn says those photos have never been properly analysed, and that diaries Adamski wrote have been read by a man named Glenn Steckling. If true, both could still hold answers about what Adamski saw.
